$comment: Mappa FUN_xxx -> nomi/desc. Gli ID FUN_ restano stabili ovunque (file, unit, Ghidra); qui il livello umano. Verificati byte-level salvo nota.

FUN_0000b3be.name: WaitRaster0
FUN_0000b3be.desc: Attende riga raster 0 (VHPOSR basso==0), base CUSTOM in A5.

FUN_0000b3a4.name: Delay6Frames
FUN_0000b3a4.desc: 6x bsr a WaitRaster0 (0x1A oltre slice): delay ~6 frame.

FUN_0000b3d4.name: CopperFadeStep
FUN_0000b3d4.desc: Step fade palette su copper list: nibble alto -0x10, basso -1, per 16 colori.

FUN_0000b432.name: FadeStepWait
FUN_0000b432.desc: Chiama CopperFadeStep, setup A0/D0, cade in WaitRaster0 (no RTS). Frammento 14B.

FUN_0000b85a.name: IrqHandler_Keyboard
FUN_0000b85a.desc: Handler IRQ livello 3: test INTENAR/INTREQR, delay, ack INTREQ=$8, decode scancode CIA, matrice $BB66, menu keys, RTE. 508B.

FUN_000131ea.name: IrqHandler_Ack
FUN_000131ea.desc: Handler IRQ: salva tutto, chiama worker, ack INTREQ=$74, RTE.

FUN_0001313c.name: InstallIrqVector
FUN_0001313c.desc: Installa IrqHandler_Ack in vettore $6C (salva vecchio in $13302), INTENA $3FF7/$C008/$8020, wait CIA, restore.

FUN_000132a4.name: MuteAudio
FUN_000132a4.desc: Volumi audio a 0 + DMACON=$F (ferma DMA audio).

FUN_00013206.name: BuildSoundTables
FUN_00013206.desc: Trova max in tabella 128B, costruisce 15 ptr, azzera, mute, init vars.

FUN_00013554.name: SoundCmd_Process
FUN_00013554.desc: Processa comando audio via struct A6 (tabelle A3, out A5): setup voci, DMACON, switch $B-$F (slide/copy/flag/motor/select).

FUN_000133fe.name: SoundTick
FUN_000133fe.desc: Tick sonoro: 4 voci via SoundCmd_Process, delay, DMACON=$8000|flags, start voci AUDx, avanza posizione/loop.
